name: scales
blurb: Overlapping circles grow and shrink in a hypnotic wave pattern.
description: Animated background with staggered scaling circles; uses requestAnimationFrame for smooth motion; requires sized container.
use_when: Immersive hero section or full-screen background for premium visual impact.
avoid_when: Touch-only devices or low-performance contexts; requires absolute positioning with defined dimensions.
a11y: Decorative background. Does not respond to prefers-reduced-motion.
